jobs.description:
Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do

• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to KnowYou’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:

• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the teams. Your tasks will include:

• Maintenance and monitoring of electrical systems, such as switchboards, electrical installations, and emergency repairs;
• Supervision of gas installations, ensuring safety and proper functioning of these systems;
• Maintenance of HVAC systems (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning), ensuring adequate temperature and air quality in buildings;
• Diagnostics and repair of heating systems.

Profile:

• You have completed technical training and have relevant experience 
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics
• You can work in a 6-shift system and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge
• You speak good English.

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:Are you seeking a new challenge where you can utilize your physical strength and precision? Our client, a renowned company in pallet production, is looking for a Robot Operator for Pallet Production.

As a Robot Operator for Pallet Production, you will be responsible for operating the production robot. Your role includes preparing the workstation: arranging planks and components on the worktable, which are then automatically assembled by the robot. The job requires physical effort, is repetitive in nature, and takes place in a noisy environment. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is up for the challenge.

Your tasks include:

• Preparing and placing planks and components on the worktable.
• Operating and monitoring the production robot.
• Ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.
• Collaborating with the team to ensure smooth production processes.

Profile DescriptionWhat are we looking for?

We are seeking an energetic and physically strong individual who meets the following requirements:

• You are physically fit and comfortable with repetitive tasks.
• You are flexible: until September, you will work in a day shift, and afterward in a two-shift system (morning and afternoon shifts).
• You can communicate in Dutch or English to collaborate effectively with the team.
• You work accurately and have attention to detail.
• You have prior experience in a production environment.

Our client, company founded in 1948, is a Belgian family business specializing in exterior joinery. Their  Group covers a range of production units. The business unit Extrusion & Finishing extrudes, anodizes and enamels aluminum profiles. Our client specializes in custom-made exterior joinery in PVC, aluminum and wood. In addition to windows and doors, many additional products are also made, such as garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:

Without solid maintenance, there is no quality! As a maintenance technician, you will be responsible for monitoring wear and tear, tracking faults, analyzing causes, proposing solutions, and optimizing production processes. Your tasks will include:

• Routine inspections and preventive maintenance.
• Risk analysis.
• Working with top-quality machines and equipment.
By collaborating with external partners, you will have the opportunity to critically assess our client’s processes and advise management and production personnel on improving their machinery park. Working in their team also means continuous development, both individually and as part of a team

Candidate Profile:

• Preferred education: Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering, or equivalent experience.
• Open to all levels of experience - from junior to experienced specialists.
• Commitment and practical approach to work.
• Solid knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics.
• Curiosity and passion for technology.
• Attention to accuracy and safety in the workplace.
• Flexibility and willingness to work in shifts.
• Precision, attention to detail, and efficiency.
• Teamwork and communication skills.
• Openness to participating in the on-call system.
• Basic/communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

Our client is a leader in the wind energy industry.

Jobomschrijving

The main responsibilities for this position are: providing maintenance, repair and support for wind turbines throughout Belgium to ensure the continuous operation of the machines.

The team leaves in the morning with a van from a service point. The service points are in: Jabbeke, Lokeren, Stabroek (Antwerp/Kapellen).

Profile:

- as wind turbine technician you have a bachelor's degree in a technical field or professional experience in a similar position

- knowledge of mechanics and/or electricity

- able to work at very high heights and in limited space

- you have a B driver's license

- you can speak English, French or Dutch

You are responsible for repairs or maintenance work on industrial vehicles, such as waste trucks, special trucks for abroad and so on.

All those vehicles are build by us.

This includes full diagnosis, maintenance, repair of claims, ...

• Experience as a mechanic or passion to work on vehicles

• You are handy and you are passionate about technology

• school leaver car mechanics is certainly possible

• Dutch or English

Compliance • Conformity • Governance • Operational Readiness • License to Operate
  
 
  
PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
  
Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
  
 
  
About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
  
 
  
Your Mission: as a PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
  
 
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
 
  
Compliance & Conformity Management
    
• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation.  
• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate
    
• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution.  
• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation.  
• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

Education & Experience
    
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline.  
• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects.  
• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management.  
• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset.  
• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;  
• Occupational safety and statutory inspections;  
• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.   
Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
  
Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
  
 
  
Competencies
  
You:
    
• Translate complexity into structure and action.  
• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders.  
• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities.  
• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills.  
• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery.  
• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.   
Languages
    
• Dutch: Fluent  
• English: Professional proficiency  
• French: Strong asset   
You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

As Key Account Manager, you grow the company's business with industrial customers across Europe. You look after existing customers, and you bring in new ones. You spend a lot of time visiting customers, and you work closely with the logistics and purchasing team at headquarters.
    
• Manage and develop existing key accounts in Europe  
• Winning new customers in the company's current markets and applications  
• Spot and develop new projects with customers, from the first technical conversation through to supply  
• Negotiate prices and terms, keeping the agreed margins in mind  
• Prepare the yearly sales budget, track volumes and margin every month  
• Keep a close eye on the market, competitors and customer needs, and share what you learn with the team 
  
• At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales in the chemical industry; experience in coatings, adhesives, sealants or polymer applications is a strong plus  
• You have built your own network of customers in the industry and can add value from your first day  
• You like developing new business and you are fully hands-on; you get your energy from working with customers  
• You think like an entrepreneur and understand financial figures, because you manage your own budget and margins  
• You are interested in the technical side of the products and can talk about them confidently with buyers and R&D teams  
• You are fluent in English, any other European language is an asset  
• You are happy to travel regularly to customers across Europe

Your role: payroll expertise with room to grow 

Own the payroll essentials
  
• Coordinate Belgian payroll administration for approximately 30 employees, working with external payroll partners and ensuring timely, accurate input and follow-up. 
• Manage employee records, contracts, absences, benefits and personnel changes. 
• Act as a first point of contact for payroll and day-to-day HR questions. 
• Help maintain accurate HR reporting and compliance with Belgian employment requirements.  
Become involved in broader HR
  
• Coordinate onboarding and offboarding, ensuring new colleagues feel welcome and supported. 
• Contribute to employee benefits, mobility and cafeteria plan initiatives. 
• Help improve HR processes, procedures and employee-facing information. 
• Support recruitment coordination, training, engagement and other HR projects.  
You'll be trusted to take ownership of your work, while collaborating closely with experienced HR colleagues. The aim is to give you meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to keep learning—not to expect you to know every aspect of HR already.

Is this your next step? 
 
• Around three years or more of relevant experience in Belgian payroll and HR administration, including benefits. 
• Enough practical payroll knowledge to take ownership of day-to-day coordination quickly; SD Worx experience is a strong advantage. 
• Good knowledge of Belgian employment administration, confidence with Excel and an interest in HR systems. 
• Excellent English, Dutch at minimum B2 level with a B1 in French. French-speaking candidates with B2 Dutch and excellent English are equally welcome. 
• An organised, accurate, proactive and service-minded approach; you enjoy helping people and taking initiative. 
• A genuine interest in broadening your HR experience and building a lasting role in a collaborative team.  
A background in a law firm or consultancy, or a specific HR degree, is welcome but not required.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
  
 
  
You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
  
Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

  
• Degree: You have a Master's degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset.  
• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment.  
• Skills:  
•      
• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field.   
• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail.   
• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact.   
• You work independently and in a disciplined manner.   
• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken).    
• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.

Purpose and Mission
 

To ensure Bexco Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert are the solution of choice in offshore operations applications (Single Point Mooring & Lifting Solutions). Organize and manage all commercial activity related to offshore operations. Create opportunities and secure orders to ensure the business meets its commercial objectives in line with the profit plan and agreed objectives and strategies.
This opportunity is ideally suited for a 
junior professional with a strong commercial drive and the ambition to grow in an international environment. The position involves 
approximately 40% international travel to build and strengthen customer relationships and explore new business opportunities.
 

Key Activities and Responsibilities
 

1. Identify concrete market potential, emerging trends, and industry shifts, including targeted qualification of key (lead) accounts within defined Single Point Mooring (SPM) applications. 
2. Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships between the organization and (potential) customers. 
3. Maintain and build worldwide strong network with agents. 
4. Negotiate effectively within commercial proposals to finalize sales agreements, ensuring acceptable deliverables and realistic timelines while balancing strict customer requirements with mutual commercial interests. 
5. Increase annual revenue from existing accounts by offering new products and services, identifying market opportunities and developing these into commercial solutions, and continuously evaluating the existing product range in line with 
6. Contribute to gathering relevant market intelligence by analyzing competitor products and customer feedback, and proactively adjusting commercial approaches accordingly. 
7. Collaborate closely with internal departments/teams to ensure the highest product quality and performance in order to fully meet customer expectations. 
8. Initiate and personally follow up on new R&D projects based on market perspectives and customer requirements. 
9. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
10. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
11. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
12. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
13. Ensure accurate (pre-)sales administration, including quotation management, technical support coordination, contract compliance, sales order booking, lead-time and deliverable tracking, communication with support departments, customer payment follow-up, and non-conformity processes. 
14. Maintain up-to-date theoretical and practical technical knowledge relevant to the segment. 
15. Achieve segment sales results by meeting budgeted revenue and sales targets. 
16. Position Bexco Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert at the center of the offshore lifting ecosystem, building positive relationships with lifting engineers, rigging specialists, operators, and other stakeholders to ensure our products are widely accepted and specified in tenders. 
17. Responsible for visual inspection of slings, ensuring accurate assessment, proper documentation, and compliance with regulatory requirements. 
18. Attend proof load tests, ensuring all procedures were performed to the required standards and verifying that goods met criteria for successful delivery.

• Strong commercial acumen with a track record of positive results in previous sales, business development, or project 
management roles. 
• Experience in offshore lifting, mooring, heavy lifting, or similar industries is a strong advantage. 
• Ability to develop and manage multiple accounts, balancing long-term relationship building with short-term revenue generation. 
• Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders. 
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrix management organization and collaborate across internal teams to deliver high-quality solutions. 
• Ability to analyze key sales data and translate findings into actionable business strategies. 
• Self-starter, able to work independently with minimal supervision, while also being a team player. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Dutch is a plus. 
• Technical understanding of materials, structural integrity, and the ability to interpret technical drawings. 
• Proficiency with CRM/ERP systems and Microsoft Office. 
• Willingness to travel internationally up to 40% of the time.
 

Qualifications and Education
 

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, industrial sciences, business administration, or equivalent through experience, with a passion for mechanics, material science, and offshore engineering.

jobs.occupation: Operator Automotive | Protection & Finishing of New Vehicles
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities

 
• Clean and prepare vehicles before treatment
 
• Mask components that should not be coated
 
• Apply protective coatings using professional spraying equipment
 
• Perform quality checks on finished vehicles
 
• Report any irregularities or defects
 
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

Who Are We Looking For?

 
• You enjoy physical and hands-on work
 
• You have an eye for detail and take pride in delivering quality work
 
• You communicate fluently in either English or Dutch
 
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence and are comfortable driving both manual and automatic vehicles
 
• You are reliable, eager to learn, and enjoy working as part of a team
 
• Experience in automotive, production, vehicle maintenance, bodywork, or spray painting is an advantage, but not required

Our client, located in the Mechelen region, specializes in the production and printing of paper, cardboard and polyethylene packaging.

We are looking for a motivated person to join the team. You will be responsible for producing and packaging various types of paper and cardboard packaging for the food industry.

• You produce and package various types of paper and cardboard packaging for the food industry.
• You set up the machine according to the packaging to be produced.
• You are responsible for your machine, check the settings and make adjustments when necessary.
• You keep track of production data and follow up on production orders. 
• You work closely with the technical team regarding planning, deviations and maintenance.
• You carry out quality checks on the products to detect any deviations.
• You are a reliable member of a close-knit team and contribute to ensuring production continuity.

REF: MEC

• You have at least a few years of experience as a Technical Line Operator
• You have experience working with mechanical production machinery
• You have a stable employment history
• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch, French or English.

The role

• You will join the Business Process Team and shape how network operations work.
• End-to-end processes that drive network transformation and automation are yours to design, improve and govern.
• Business stakeholders, operational teams and technical teams find their connection in you, as you translate business needs into clear processes, requirements and functional specifications.
• Using the BPMN 2.0 standard, you model AS-IS and TO-BE processes.
• KPIs help you monitor process performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, automation and customer experience.
• Your scope covers the network lifecycle, from planning and rollout to activation, service assurance, maintenance and sometimes phase-out.
• Complex challenges become clear, effective processes that support efficient, scalable and future-ready telecom operations.

Desired profile

• Experience in process management, continuous improvement or business analysis, preferably in telecommunications
• Experience managing cross-functional projects, including adoption and organizational change
• The following are an asset:
• hands-on experience with BPMN 2.0 and ARIS or a comparable modelling tool
• good knowledge of telecom networks, or the curiosity and drive to quickly build and apply this knowledge
💡 Your skills

• Business needs are something you gather, challenge and translate into process and functional requirements.
• Workshops, interviews, process reviews and gap analyses are familiar ground, and you facilitate them with ease.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills help you move topics forward.
• Operational teams, tool owners, and process and IT architects all find in you a good partner to work with.
• Strong communication in Dutch and/or French is combined with a working knowledge of English.
🌟 Who are you?

• Autonomous and assertive, with natural leadership
• A strong communicator with a customer-oriented mindset
• Flexible, both in business and technical matters
• Rigorous in your approach

This Belgian manufacturer of dry powder mixtures for the construction industry (mortars, adhesives, plasters, etc.), located in the Port of Antwerp, is looking to strengthen its current team with a motivated OPERATOR.

As an OPERATOR, you will be responsible for all operational tasks required during your shift for production and loading activities. You will play a crucial role in the production process and will be widely deployable across various production lines, from mixing processes to bagging.

Your responsibilities as an OPERATOR* will include:

• Preparing, weighing and accurately dosing raw materials and additives for mixing processes, particularly liquids.
• Monitoring and operating mixing and filling machines, such as dissolvers, mixing tanks and filling equipment.
• Operating, converting and setting up bagging machines.
• Setting up and loading packaging materials (e.g. film) onto the machines.
• Carrying out process checks and visual inspections of the finished product, such as checking viscosity and colour consistency.
• Replacing simple mechanical components on the production lines.
• Processing residual product and cleaning the factory, including cleaning mixing equipment and pipelines.
• Assisting drivers during loading operations.
• Carrying out internal transport and logistical activities using a forklift and/or reach truck.

REF:MEC

Experience & Profile

• You have proven relevant work experience as an OPERATOR in a production environment.
• Experience with mixing, dispersing or filling liquids, or operating bagging and packaging machines, is preferred.
• A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate is a major advantage.
• You are familiar with terminology and techniques used in the mixing industry, such as batch production, dosing and basic quality control
• You have a technical aptitude and a strong problem-solving mindset.
• You are communicative and have a good command of Dutch or English

CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.
• You are responsible for the proper inspection and care of your truck and trailer.
You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC

• You have a valid CE driving licence and Code 95
• Previous experience with container transport is preferred.
• Experience driving in the Port of Antwerp is a strong advantage.
• An  ADR certificate is a strong advantage.
• You are a safe and responsible driver.
• You are punctual, reliable and customer-oriented.
• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager Copper Phase Out - Telecom
jobs.description:
The offer

• As a Project Manager you will join the Copper Phase-Out team and help accelerate the migration of customers from copper-based services to fibre.
• Customer migrations are yours to coordinate, with a strong focus on operational efficiency and customer continuity, action plans stay on track because you follow up on deadlines and dependencies.
• Together with the cross-functional teams, you validate migration paths and ensure their feasibility, internal stakeholders rely on you to support decision-making, resolve issues and keep departments aligned.
